items.title: UK retail group Frasers partners Visa for virtual card
items.why: Retailer loyalty tied to a Visa virtual card is a template for co-brand outreach to merchants with large customer bases.
items.summary_ai: UK retailer Frasers Group partnered with Visa to launch the Frasers Plus Virtual Visa card.
items.take: Retailer loyalty tied to a Visa virtual card is a template for co-brand outreach to merchants with large customer bases.
